note: Eight isolated native K3s fixtures cover CLI/Helm, both scopes and architectures. Each upgrades actual published 0.5.2 with interruption/resume, refuses the shared-schema downgrade, executes fresh frozen base/toolchain builds with unknown and explicit placement, checks warm/disabled caches and source denial, and verifies complete retained OCI graphs after current-version uninstall/reinstall. Four actual Argo CD cases cover the isolated future-version chart round trip, interruptions, self-heal and retention. The conformance version is not a public release. Components use a fixture TLS mirror with unchanged official index digests. Real mixed-cluster native image-input execution, later platform demand and public-artifact verification are recorded separately.
